title: A few concepts every lesson returns to
statement: Organise a unit and a course around a few fixed concepts that every lesson returns to and adds to, and record which of them each lesson draws on.
example: One course consolidated 14 concept pairs into 7 course-long threads.
detail: A lesson walkthrough, in a version since superseded, brings back a five-row pattern chart in every lesson of its unit and fills it row by row, so the schema accumulates instead of being covered once (`downloads/SUPERSEDED — see v2.1_ WITW Lesson 1 learning walkthrough v2 (table format).md`); another unit's knowledge base sets one pattern that every text tests (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Instruction/3.3 - Ancient Civilisations - Lesson Designs/3.3 Ancient Civilisations - Knowledge Base - Full.xlsx`). Across the course, a fixed bank of 14 concept pairs is consolidated into 7 threads (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Curriculum maps/1. Mapping Docs/Grade_3-12_Full_Thematic_Map.xlsx`), and a unit's concept map records which pairs each lesson draws on (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Instruction/3.1 - Fantasy Classics - Lesson Designs/3.1 - Fantasy Classics - Knowledge Base (Complete).xlsx`). These are design rules; no outcome was measured.

Your 14 concept-pairs, consolidated into 7 course-long threads.

1. **Retrieval is built in, not bolted on.** The child sees last lesson's answer at the moment they need it, so the opening check has something real to activate. This is R-KC-5, activating prior knowledge without re-teaching it. 2. **The scaffold fades on a schedule that is visible to everyone.** Filled rows are the support. Each lesson removes one, because each lesson asks the child to write the row that used to be given.

The row is completed by the child's own written or chosen answer on the same page, not by the guide writing it up afterwards. That is deliberate: a `frame` whose rows arrive already filled shows the child a finished summary and calls it modelling, which is exactly the failure `think_aloud` exists to prevent.

Chronology alone is insufficient. A lesson earns its place by adding a named mechanism or forcing a previous mechanism to explain new evidence.
**F1: Chronology dump.** Detection: lessons only follow dates and no recurring mechanism is reused. Recovery: add the missing revisit activation and make it do explanatory work.
A purely chronological outline can become a sequence of summaries with no compounding operation.
